The earlier answer failed because "Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance" appears several times on page 7, so no single quote was unique. A row-based quote would have to be read straight down the X-ray row's own column, and a quote cannot span the blank lines and "*" in that row. The in-network and out-of-network lines are separate lines in one column, and the text between them includes "$50 copay *". A quote joining "Outpatient X-rays In-Network $50 copay * Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance" mixes the service-name column with the cost column, so that is not allowed either.

The cost column read down for that row is "In-Network $50 copay * Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance". That is one column read straight down, joined with single spaces, and it occurs once on the page because of the $50 copay. It shows the number 30.

I can't fix this fact with certainty beyond that quote, so I use it.

```json
[{"plan_id":"H5439-015-0","benefit":"imaging.xray","setting":"any","network":"out","covered_by":"medicare","cost_kind":"coinsurance","amount":"30%","unit":"","limit":"","page":7,"quotes":["In-Network $50 copay * Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance"],"note":""}]
```
